high_confidence_findings.fact: SpscSignalRingBuffer<T> is not referenced by first-party source except its own declaration file. Active SignalBus<T> storage uses NativeQueue<T> plus optional NativeQueue<T>.ParallelWriter.
evidence: Spsc only self-references: Assets/_Project/Scripts/Core/Signals/SpscSignalRingBuffer.cs:11,20,25.
SignalBus<T> declares NativeQueue<T> at SignalBusRuntime.cs:305.
SignalBus<T> exposes NativeQueue<T>.ParallelWriter at SignalBusRuntime.cs:395-408 and 421-427.
high_confidence_findings.sync_consequence: Future agents must not assume SignalBus<T> uses the SPSC ring. The SPSC buffer is a standalone fallback primitive, while active high-frequency signal lanes are NativeQueue-backed and can accept legacy MPSC writers.

high_confidence_findings.fact: PaddedSignalIndex is explicitly 64 bytes, but SpscSignalRingBuffer<T> has no explicit parent layout or 64-byte alignment guarantee for _head and _tail field starts.
evidence: PaddedSignalIndex explicit layout and size: SpscSignalRingBuffer.cs:94-105.
_head and _tail fields are default-layout parent fields: SpscSignalRingBuffer.cs:17-18.
No StructLayout attribute exists on SpscSignalRingBuffer<T>: SpscSignalRingBuffer.cs:11.
high_confidence_findings.sync_consequence: Head and tail each occupy a 64-byte nested struct, but cache-line isolation is not byte-perfectly guaranteed unless the parent instance and field offsets are 64-byte aligned by runtime allocation.

high_confidence_findings.fact: SignalBusRegistry.Register mutates _laneCount and _dispatchLaneCount using plain increments and array writes. Dispatch readers use Volatile.Read on _dispatchLaneCount, but registration itself has no lock, CAS, or Interlocked reservation.
evidence: _laneCount and _dispatchLaneCount fields: SignalBusRuntime.cs:48-49.
Duplicate scan and lane writes: SignalBusRuntime.cs:90-116.
_dispatchLaneCount++ inside registry write: SignalBusRuntime.cs:110.
Flush reads dispatch count with Volatile.Read: SignalBusRuntime.cs:244-247.
high_confidence_findings.sync_consequence: Correct only under cold single-threaded lane registration before concurrent dispatch. Concurrent first-touch initialization of different SignalBus<T> lanes can race registration table writes.

high_confidence_findings.fact: SignalBusRegistry.FlushPreSimulation only dispatches lane flush delegates. It does not complete producer jobs or fence NativeQueue<T>.ParallelWriter producers before consumers drain queues.
evidence: Registry flush entry: SignalBusRuntime.cs:147-153.
Dispatch loop calls delegate directly: SignalBusRuntime.cs:244-258.
SignalBus<T>.FlushPreSimulation drains _queue.TryDequeue: SignalBusRuntime.cs:783-880.
ParallelWriter facade exists: SignalBusRuntime.cs:395-408 and 421-427.
high_confidence_findings.sync_consequence: The dispatcher phase outside this file must guarantee all producers are complete before flush. This file contains no local JobHandle ownership or completion window.

high_confidence_findings.fact: SignalBus<T> queue is Unity NativeQueue<T>, whose Count property traverses an internal linked list of blocks; this differs from a fixed power-of-two SPSC ring buffer with O(1) cursor arithmetic.
evidence: NativeQueue<T> source states Count requires traversing linked list: NativeQueue.cs:66-77.
SignalBus<T>.TryPush checks _queue.Count >= _expectedCapacity: SignalBusRuntime.cs:597.
SignalBus<T>.FlushPreSimulation reads _queue.Count at SignalBusRuntime.cs:809 and again at 847.
high_confidence_findings.sync_consequence: The active SignalBus<T> path is bounded by policy counters and frame-limit shedding, not by SPSC mask-wrapped fixed storage.

cursor_algorithm.spsc_contract_risk: Algorithm is SPSC only. Multiple producers can observe same tail/full state and overwrite the same slot because there is no CAS reservation. Multiple consumers can read same head slot for the same reason.

signal_lane_dispatch_layout.reason: Contains managed delegate references. Not an unmanaged/native DTO; exact size depends on CLR/IL2CPP object/reference layout.

registration_sequence.operation: Register receives dispose/flush/clear/telemetry delegates and returns if dispose is null.
Linear duplicate check by ReferenceEquals against existing dispose delegate slots.
If _laneCount >= 512, Volatile.Write registration overflow flag and return.
Store dispose and telemetry delegates at laneIndex = _laneCount.
If flush and clear are both non-null, store SignalLaneDispatch at _laneDispatch[_dispatchLaneCount++] with pause flag.

flush_sequence.operation: FlushPreSimulation reads _systemStressMilli with Volatile.Read, reads SimulationSignalRoute.SimulationPaused, then calls FlushRegisteredSignalLanes.
For each dispatch record, skip null delegates or paused lanes without pause permission; otherwise invoke dispatch.Flush(systemStressMilli).

clear_sequence.operation: For each dispatch record, invoke dispatch.Clear() if non-null.

dispose_sequence.operation: Copy _laneCount to local laneCount; invoke each non-null dispose delegate.
Null dispose/telemetry slots and default dispatch records.
Reset counts and volatile scalar/latch flags.

atomic_operations.operation: Volatile.Read for registry public/cold scalar accessors.

initialization.operation: Apply defaults, register delegates, reject invalid payload stride.
Acquire frame snapshot buffer or dispose queue on failure.
Prewarm queue and allocate NativeArray<int>[2] writer budget.

try_push_main_thread_path.operation: Stress-based load shedding for non-critical VFX using Interlocked counters.
Copy payload, sanitize finite values, publish guard telemetry on rejection.
Fatal signal sets simulation halt via SignalBusRegistry.SetSimulationHalted().
Enqueue sanitized payload, update latest signal, increment accepted total.

parallel_writer_path.operation: TryEnqueueBounded obtains raw int* to writer budget and Interlocked.Decrement claims one slot.
If budget below zero, Interlocked.Increment dropped counter and return false.

frame_flush.operation: Open snapshot for owner write; reset count/read cursor; increment generation.
Consume pending drop counters with Interlocked.Exchange and reset budget.
Read queue count; calculate continuous frame limit from quality/stress/profile; clamp to snapshot length.
If queued > 1024, drop all, publish degradation, set kill switch, return.
Drop oldest overflow beyond current frame limit.
TryDequeue up to copyLimit, sanitize, coalesce or append into snapshot.
Update coalesce/load/corrupt counters and optionally sort deterministic snapshot.

snapshot_reads.operation: GetFrameSnapshot returns ReadOnlySpan<T> over unsafe read-only pointer.
GetFrameSnapshotArray creates NativeArray read-only view from unsafe pointer.
TryReadFrameSnapshot resolves read-only vault handle and clamps count to frameSnapshot.Length.
